content: Ga Yesu wate tonono nidi ꞌediya ꞌiona, “Niꞌatu yage nidi getedi yasimanedi ꞌemiya be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo ꞌeguyega wabeꞌubeꞌu.
Manuna maꞌetamo anuwa tapwaloloega sipaꞌimi, ta wate maꞌetamo tuta ꞌimeemai be ꞌabo yaita ꞌida loemwawasimi, tauna ꞌinuwanuwa ꞌaene gete Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebe gwausowala.
ꞌIdi guinuwa getedi toꞌumalidi ꞌemiya sida guinuwedi manuna nigeya Tamagu be ꞌaboꞌagu simwalamwalatonima.

Yage nidi getedi niꞌatu yasimanedi ꞌemiya, be ꞌenega tuta nina ꞌabo siapwesa ꞌemiya wada nuwaꞌiꞌisidi.” Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina paisewa Ta wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Yage nidi getedi nigeya lowa yagimigimi simanedi ꞌemiya, manuna tuta yauyauna ꞌaboꞌagu maꞌemi.

Ta esi niꞌatu be yatatauya tauna ꞌietuneguma ꞌenaya, ꞌenega yage nidi gete tuga yagieapwesedi ꞌemiya. Ta niꞌatu gete be yapilisinemi, ta nigeya ꞌebweu ꞌemiyega yaita ꞌienaenaidegu be nai ꞌida gwae, ‘Mwaꞌo ꞌutautauya?’
Ta ꞌenega ꞌigu ona manudi nuwami simwau sinabwana.

Ta esi yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya ꞌaene boboꞌana ꞌabo yapilisinemi, manuna ꞌabo nigeya yapilipili sinemi tolema nina geyaꞌabo ꞌimeema. Ta ꞌabo yapilisinemi be yatatauya, maꞌetamo tolema nina yada etunenama ꞌemiya.
Ga tuta nina ꞌabo ꞌimamai, ꞌomi me baleꞌu yage ꞌetoi ꞌida eꞌitami be wada mwalatonidi. Yage nidi nate guinuwa toꞌumalina be guinuwa boboꞌana be wate bwaꞌomatana.
ꞌEnega ꞌida eꞌitami ꞌaene ꞌabo nigeya waemiemisegu, ꞌomi nate guinuwa toꞌumalina ꞌana toguinuwao.
Ta tauna wate bubuna palupaluna ꞌida eꞌitami, manuna ꞌaboꞌagu niꞌatu be yatatauya Tamagu ꞌenaya be geyaꞌabo wate waꞌitaꞌitagu.
Ta wate tauna bwaꞌomatana ꞌida eꞌitami ꞌaene niꞌatu bwaꞌomatana ꞌimai saba baleꞌuya, manuna baleꞌu ꞌana toloina nina ꞌina guinuwa toꞌumalina ꞌenega ꞌana bwaꞌomatana ꞌilobena.
“Ta eꞌita yau wawasae simiyami, ta esi geyaꞌabo maiboꞌana tuta gete yasimasimanedi ꞌemiya, manuna nigeya sawesawemiya be wamwalatonidi.

Ta maꞌetamo Yaluyaluwa ꞌesaꞌesasena ꞌimamai, tauna ꞌida anuganemi yage palupaludi maiboꞌadi ꞌediya. Ta tauna geyaꞌabo ꞌina nuwenuwega ꞌionaona, ta esi toꞌase nadigega ꞌinonodi ꞌida onaedi, ta wate ꞌida eonami yage matamiya manudi.
Ta ꞌigu sinasinapuyega ꞌemiya ꞌida eꞌita be ꞌenega ꞌagu esana wada gituꞌeye.
Ta wate toꞌase nadigega Tamagu ꞌina yage, maiboꞌana ꞌaboꞌagu tuga ꞌigu yage. Nate ꞌenega yagwae, ‘ꞌIgu sinasinapuyega ꞌemiya ꞌida eꞌita.’ ”
Nuwamwau ꞌida gibuni gwausowala ꞌena
ꞌEnega Yesu wate ꞌediya ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu tuta gidalina ꞌena be geyaꞌabo wate waꞌitaꞌitagu, ta ꞌenega tuta gidalina maꞌetamo ꞌena wada ꞌitalimagu.”

Ta ꞌaidi ꞌina tononoyao gosediyao ꞌediya sigwae, “Toꞌase ꞌina ona gete ꞌana mwalatoi? Manuna ꞌedaya ꞌiona, ‘Tuta gidalina ꞌena be geyaꞌabo wate waꞌitaꞌitagu, ta tuta gidalina maꞌetamo ꞌena wada ꞌitalimagu’, ta wate ꞌedaya ꞌiona, ‘Manuna yatatauya Tamagu ꞌena’.
Toꞌase getedi ‘Tuta gidalina’ ꞌana mwalatoi?” ꞌEnega sigwae, “ꞌIyaugwa! Nigeya tamwalamwalatoni toꞌase manuna ꞌionaona.”

Ta Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌidi nuwanuwa ꞌimwalatonidi be ꞌaene nuwanuwadi ꞌenaya sida enaida, ꞌenega ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Toꞌase manuna taumimo waenaenaidemi? ꞌAene manuna yagwae, ‘Tuta gidalina ꞌena be geyaꞌabo wate waꞌitaꞌitagu, ta tuta gidalina maꞌetamo ꞌena wada ꞌitalimagu’, aga?
Yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya ꞌaene maꞌetamo ma imi nuwamwau wadedoi, ta esi me baleꞌu maiboꞌadi sigwausowala. Ta ꞌomi maꞌetamo wanuwamwau ta ꞌimi nuwamwau nina ꞌida gibuni be wagwausowala.
“Nadigega tuga ꞌabo waine ꞌina tuta enatuna ꞌenaya ꞌelouya ꞌilobaloba, ta ꞌabo ꞌina enatuna mulinaya ꞌelouya maiboꞌana ꞌinuwapupuledi, manuna gwama niꞌatu ꞌitubuwa ga ma ina gwausowala.

Ta ꞌomi nadigega tuga, manuna mwau ꞌemiya tuta gete, ta maꞌetamo yailama be wada ꞌitagu, ꞌenega manugu wada gwausowala ꞌaiꞌaila. Ta gwausowala nina tauna geyaꞌabo yaita wate ꞌemiyega ꞌiꞌewaꞌewa yaule.
“Ta ꞌabo tuta nina ꞌimamai, ꞌomi geyaꞌabo toꞌase manuna waenaenaida ꞌeguya. Ta yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya, ꞌeguma ꞌagu esanega Tamagu ꞌena toꞌase manuna wasisida, ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌemi tuga.
Ta lowaenei ga batuwa nigeya wate ꞌebweu toꞌase manuna ꞌagu esanega wasidasida. ꞌEnega gete tuga wasisida be ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌemi, ꞌenega wada gwausowala ꞌaiꞌaila.”
Yesu loina baleꞌu ꞌiewaiwai sinena

Ta Yesu wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu ona semalimaliyega yage getedi yasimanedi ꞌemiya. Ta maꞌetamo tuta ꞌida mai be geyaꞌabo wate ona semalimaliyega yaeonami, ta esi Tamagu manuna yada onaapwesa ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya.
Ta tuta maꞌetamo ꞌenaya ꞌomi ꞌagu esanega wasisida Yaubada ꞌenaya, ta geyaꞌabo ꞌaboꞌagu manumi yasidasida,
manuna Tamagu tauna niꞌatu ꞌiobobomemi. Ta ꞌina oboboma nina ꞌalena manuna ꞌomi waobobomegu, ta wate waemisegu ꞌaene Yaubada ꞌenega yamai.
ꞌAboꞌagu Tamagu ꞌenega yamai ga baleꞌuya yamiyami, ꞌenega gete tuga baleꞌu yapilipilisine ta yailaila Tamagu ꞌena.”
ꞌEnega ꞌina tononoyao sinonona ga sieonena, sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, gete tuga niꞌatu ꞌuona apwesa ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemaya, ta nigeya ona semalimaliyega.

Gete ꞌenega niꞌatu ꞌamwalatoi ꞌaiꞌailimu ꞌaene ꞌoyo yage yauyaudi ꞌumwalamwalatonidi. ꞌEnega geyaꞌabo wate ꞌaenaenaideyo, manuna niꞌatu ꞌima nuwanuwa maiboꞌadi ꞌumwalamwalatonidi. ꞌEnega tuga ꞌaemiseyo ꞌaene ꞌoyo Yaubada ꞌenega ꞌumai.”
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi ga ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu waemisegu, aga?

Ta maꞌetamo tuta ꞌida apwesama, nai tada gwae, ‘Niꞌatu tuta ꞌimai saba’, be maiboꞌami wada ꞌelelewana ꞌimi ꞌasao ꞌediya, be ꞌaboꞌagu tebweugu yada miyami. Ta nigeya ꞌaene tebweugumo ta esi Tamagu maꞌiyagu.

Ona gete yasimanena ꞌemiya be ꞌenega ma imi gwausowala wada miyami, manuna ꞌaboꞌagu maꞌemi. Ta maꞌetamo baleꞌuya wamiyamwau, ta tuwa tuga wada ꞌatepatu, manuna ꞌaboꞌagu loina baleꞌu yaewaiwai sinena.”
